# VIKAS EDA Tool

> VIKAS is an open-source EDA project by Sairam Ginnela: a Rust CLI and TypeScript workbench for selected Verilog/SystemVerilog RTL simulation, static hardware checks, and waveform workflows.

Use the links below as the primary sources for project information. The GitHub repository, README, and release notes are authoritative for current code, setup, versions, and downloadable assets.

## Project
- [VIKAS project overview](https://www.ginnela.in/projects/vikas/)
- [Source repository and README](https://github.com/ginnela-sairam/Vikas)
- [Releases and CLI downloads](https://github.com/ginnela-sairam/Vikas/releases)
- [Getting started](https://github.com/ginnela-sairam/Vikas/blob/main/docs/GETTING_STARTED.md)
- [Example designs](https://github.com/ginnela-sairam/Vikas/tree/main/examples)

## Scope
VIKAS implements selected workflows; its static checks do not claim complete IEEE language compliance or formal equivalence. Experimental analytical outputs are software-model results, not independent measurements, foundry-calibrated data, or tapeout qualification.
